concept.title: On-premise Red Hat Quay configuration overview
concept.shortdesc: For on-premise Red Hat Quay deployments, you manage a config.yaml file that Red Hat Quay reads at container startup. You must restart the registry container after you change the file because Red Hat Quay does not reload configuration dynamically.

conbody.p: This chapter provides an overview of the following concepts:

ul.li: How to edit and manage your configuration after deployment.

conbody.p: This section applies specifically to on-premise Red Hat Quay deployment types. For information about configuring Red Hat Quay on OpenShift Container Platform, see "Red Hat Quay on OpenShift Container Platform configuration overview".
